node.title: The LIST adjacency endgame: worst-word list crosses eps*|F| at consecutive grid radii
node.statement: For each admissible row, for the ordinary code (m=1), exhibit adjacent agreements a0,a0+1 with L_1(a0) > floor(|F|/2^128) >= L_1(a0+1). This is the exact base-list closing obligation; list_large_m_scope_closure transports the same pair to every constant arity. CLEAN RATES: list_unsafe supplies the lower witness, list_safe the upper bound, and list_corridor_ledger the exact adjacent-grid collapse. RATE ONE HALF: rate_half_cyclic_rotated_prefix_floor supplies the lower side and rate_half_list_adjacent_crossing is the remaining safe-side/exact-crossing premise. The retired W3/worst-word route is evidence only.
node.attack_surface: Clean-rate live input: l1_mixed_petal_amplification through list_safe. Rate-half live input: rate_half_list_adjacent_crossing. The corridor arithmetic and unsafe witnesses are proved.
